issue_context.title: Support Tracing in CRI Remote Image Service
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

PR [105126](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/105126.) added support for tracing gRPC calls for [Remote runtime service](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/kubelet/cri/remote/remote_runtime.go#L89-L98). However, it appears that tracing is not currently supported in the [Remote Image service](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/kubelet/cri/remote/remote_image.go#L55-L58).

I think this should be a straight forward change of adding gRPC interceptors on the image service. 



### Why is this needed?

Follow up for [KEP 2831] (https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/issues/2831)
comments: @swagatbora90 do you have a PR as well?

> @swagatbora90 do you have a PR as well?
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/112709
[swagatbora90](https://github.com/swagatbora90) is there anything else that needs to be done, or should we close this?

HI @dashpole this issue can be closed now. However, there is a broader discussion to be had regarding improving the current  state of tracing with better trace correlation, instrumenting spans etc. I am planning to create a separate issue detailing the gaps and for improvement suggestions.

review_comments: I looked at couple places - it looks like context used for these calls is often a new context. Is the plan to change all the callsite to start using an incoming context?
I'm not against this PR, I think it is a good step forward. I just want to make sure there are follow up work planned to improve traces correlation

Yes, you are right. This  would only enable creation of individual traces for every request made to the runtime. For proper tracing support, we would need to instrument spans that could cover multiple gRPC calls. For example, instrumenting containerRuntime.SyncPod or even kubelet syncPod would cover multiple CRI calls which would produce more valuable traces. 

I am interested to work on the follow up tasks. The initial KEP#2832  mainly targeted tracing around http and grpc calls. And I don't see any existing issue or discussion around extending opentelemetry tracing support in kubelet for trace correlation. What will be the best way to start this discussion? Should I create an issue identifying the gaps in tracing in kubelet?

issue is a good place to discuss it.

I understand the minimal step taken here

/lgtm
/unhold
